method: Lanczos resample of the accepted Wrath fit: its recipe's registration and atlasBox [0,0,1488,1180] are in factor-6 pixels with no whole-pixel factor-4 equivalent, so re-fitting would change the accepted registration. Height re-authored from the 4x diffuse by update_enemy_heights.height_for (which reproduced the committed height first). Every other Rogue skin above 4x was re-fitted at factor 4 through its recipe (ogre/rogue1 was already 4x; the rogue0 copies follow batch 2).
